messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up from onboarding: folks are confused which env vars the CLI vs SDK respect. Sample app uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but the CLI docs mention REDWOOD_TOKEN. New users hit 401s and assume the key is invalid. Who owns parity and rotation UX?
Jordan: I reproduced this locally. SDK fallback order is env -> creds file -> metadata, but CLI has a --project-key flag that overrides env and a different token name. Not consistent. :face_with_raised_eyebrow: 
Sam: Suggest we standardize: 1) publish canonical env names, 2) SDK logs a warn when deprecated vars are used, 3) sample-apps mirror CLI precedence so onboarding is deterministic.
Ashley: Rotation note: when keys are rotated server-side some endpoints return 401, others 403. CLI only auto-refreshes ephemeral keys today. Hosted API keys require manual rotate. We should implement a clear 401->refresh attempt flow, then an actionable error if refresh fails.
Maria: Proposal: canonicalize env vars to REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT. Deprecate REDWOOD_TOKEN with a 6-month warning. Emit a telemetry event cred_source indicating which source was used.
Jordan: Proposed precedence for README + SDK docs:
```
1) CLI flag --api-key / --project-key
2) env REDWOOD_API_KEY
3) env REDWOOD_TOKEN (deprecated)
4) creds file ~/.config/redwood/creds.json
5) metadata server (GCE/GKE/EC2 role)
```
Sam: +1. Also change sample-app starter to prefer explicit CLI flags in test scripts so CI/local runs don't accidentally use metadata credentials.
Ashley: Retry behavior: on 401 do one auto-refresh if a refresh token exists; otherwise surface a clear error: 'token expired — run `redwood auth login` or set REDWOOD_API_KEY'. Avoid loops; backoff on 429s.
Maria: Another onboarding pain: project-scoped keys used against org admin endpoints give ambiguous errors. Can we add client-side detection to return 'project key lacks admin scope — use org key or service key'?
Jordan: Example snippet for SDK error helper:
```
if (status === 403 && looksLikeProjectScoped(key)) {
  throw new Error('403 — project-scoped key. Use an org-level key for this endpoint or set REDWOOD_PROJECT to the intended project.');
}
```
Sam: Implementation plan: small SDK runtime PR (~150 LOC) + CLI change to unify flag/env parsing. Add --cred-debug to print which source was chosen (strip PII).
cli-bot: deploy-bot: rolling out CLI v0.19.1 to beta with --cred-debug and cred-source telemetry. Opening canary for devex. :robot_face: 
Maria: Can someone open the RFC/issue to deprecate REDWOOD_TOKEN and draft migration steps? Add a quick line in quickstart demonstrating explicit flags to avoid surprises.
Jordan: I'll open the issue and link the SDK + sample-app PRs.
Ashley: I'll patch the retry handler and add the actionable 401 message.
Sam: I'll update sample-apps and demo scripts to prefer flags and add a test that asserts cred-source is deterministic.
Maria: Thanks all — let's sync after the canary runs tomorrow. :wave:
